sidebar.title: Workspaces
sidebar.noWorkspacesHint: Open a project or clone from URL to start from zero.

commandPalette.title: Workspace command palette
commandPalette.description: Jump to a workspace or run an action.

workspaceDialog.cloneDescription: Clone a remote repository into a local folder, then create the worktree from it. Leave base branch empty to auto-detect the remote default branch.
workspaceDialog.createDescription: New worktree from a local repo path and base branch.
workspaceDialog.chooseFolderForBranches: Choose a folder to load branches

bootstrap.title: No workspace open
bootstrap.description: Open a project or clone from URL to start from zero. The chat, inspector, and terminal surfaces will appear once a workspace exists.

empty.title: No workspace selected
empty.description: Open or create a workspace to inspect git state and session activity.

inspector.sessionFallback: No active session - start one from the composer.
inspector.terminalNote: Terminal sessions stay in the workbench drawer at the bottom of the layout - they are not mirrored here so the inspector stays focused on Git and session signals.

conversationLaunch.hint: Start from scratch with a blank thread. Use one of the prompts below or launch the session first and build from there.
conversationLaunch.footerHint: The conversation will appear here once you send the first prompt.

prompts.summarize: Summarize what this workspace already contains.
prompts.entryPoints: Find the main entry points in this repo.
prompts.nextAction: Show me the next best action to continue from zero.

settings.title: Settings
settings.currentWorkspaceHint: Repository-scoped preferences live with the active workspace.
settings.languageHint: Brazilian Portuguese by default; English available for international teams.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.description: Preview toggles and future shell flags.

general.shellBehaviorBody: The desktop shell keeps workspace chrome, the thread composer, and the inspector aligned with the blueprint.
general.defaultEntryBody: Workspaces open into the inspector-first workbench with the composer in the center pane.

appearance.themeHint: Match the shell to the system or force a fixed mode.
appearance.colorSystemHint: The color system is driven by shell tokens, so this choice changes the whole chrome instead of just the canvas.

model.providersHint: Choose the default runtime for new sessions and composer sends.

shortcuts.keyboardShortcutsHint: Command palette and composer shortcuts already wired in this shell.

git.chromeHint: Branch-aware header styling and the commit action live in the inspector.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.body: No preview toggles are exposed yet. This section stays in the nav so future shell flags land without changing the layout.

account.githubHint: Account and sync surfaces are gated behind the future integration pass.
account.footerHint: The settings dialog already reserves the account section so the footer integration can slot in later without reopening the shell contract.

intro.title: Welcome to Dev Command Center
intro.body: Start from the shell, keep your workspace visible, and let the thread stay in the center.

agents.title: Agents stay in the loop
agents.body: The inspector and composer are already primed for provider-driven sessions and runtime context.

repoImport.title: Import a repository
repoImport.body: Point the shell at a local repo or clone from URL and the workspace opens around it.

completeTransition.title: Ready to transition
completeTransition.body: Finish onboarding and drop into the shell with the same chrome the blueprint calls for.

onboarding.phase4Body: We ship intro, agents, repo import, and the completion transition first.
onboarding.conductorPreviewBody: The optional integration pass stays deferred, but the visual concept is available now.
